text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations.
Gentil-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Experience does not inherently equal a difference in capability.
I understood that, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You truly are remarkably strong.
I am full of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
First,
my thanks for your blessings.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And to your strength as well,
which you exerted to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Without resting on the fleeting glory of being a Derby Umamusume,
she must have continued to train relentlessly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Even with all the time that has passed since then, you still maintain such exceptional skill.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Adapting to the clock,
and exerting my absolute best in every single moment.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That is the power of pride in one's own journey—and I thoroughly enjoyed witnessing it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot take my hat off right now.
May I ask for a handshake instead?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wish to show you my respect.
It is the way of my homeland.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you don't have to hold back,
you can put a bit more strength into it—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Autsch!
Y-You're pouring way too much...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it.
Damn it... Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Winning with a record time,
was that really so long ago?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Am I... no good anymore?
Did I lose my strength?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: From here on, it's just...—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "However, we have our pride."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To the long journey that has led the scene up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pride, huh? Dunno anything about that.
I probably don't have any of it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even so.
Even so, though~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna chicken out.
I'm not... done yet!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The proud Shield
is also within my grasp.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, I knew you could do it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh,
is that all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Though I have been granted
a meaningful victory.
choice_data_list: Because it's a victory that's expected of us

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho... So you mean to say
that is a reaction befitting the strong?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, my answer is no.
That is merely "strength" within the realm of your imagination—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will astonish you.
By winning the Japan Cup again this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her victory last year was historic in its own right,
but if she wins for the second consecutive year—
choice_data_list: That would be a historic honor...!
It'll be the first honor of its kind in history...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No one can dispute that
the Japan Cup is the premier
race in the country.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Because the strongest of the era gather every year,
even such magnificent contenders could not secure back-to-back victories.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If she were to achieve back-to-back victories in a race like that—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Father, or anyone else for that matter... would surely give the same assessment.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That Gentildonna is indeed
"the strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us move on to the final touches.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Unleashing the power of the magnum opus
at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the culmination of her career... Gentildonna is
about to pour in everything she has built up so far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has, in fact, steadily grown stronger... and drawn closer to becoming the strongest.
If so, I must strive for even greater perfection—
choice_data_list: (I have to do work worthy of the finishing touches)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I have to put pressure on myself... and aim higher and higher!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To show the culmination of her efforts in her second Japan Cup...
The days of rigorous training begin once more."
